# openextract

> One call: schema + model + source → a validated object. Do not invent a second extraction pipeline.

## Docs

- [Guide](guide.html): install, extract, styles, batch, swarms, importable agents, CLI, errors
- [MCP for agents](mcp.html): tools, resources, prompts, Cursor config
- [API reference](api-reference.html): function catalog

## Call

| Job | Library | MCP |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One input | `extract(schema, model, input)` | `extract` |
| Many inputs | `extractMany` | `extract_many` |
| Many agents, one input | `extractSwarm` | `extract_swarm` |
| Reuse config | `Extractor` | `create_extractor` → `extractor_extract` |
| Durable | `extractWorkflow` | n/a (use `openextract/workflow`) |

## Style

- `direct` — default. Required for PDF, Office, image, audio, video.
- `search` — UTF-8 text file tools. No silent fallback.
- `code` — sandboxed JS, document as `document`. UTF-8 only.

## Schema

- TypeScript: Zod
- MCP / workflows: JSON Schema object or string, or `module:exportName`
- Agent with `outputSchema`: omit schema

## Input

Path or http(s) URL. Bytes need `mediaType`. MCP: `source` or base64 `data` + `mediaType`. Cap 50 MiB. Private URL hosts blocked unless `OPENEXTRACT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS`.

## Auth

`AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` or Vercel OIDC. Default model: `OPENEXTRACT_MODEL`.

```bash
npx openextract-mcp
```
